hook: Let's turn terahash into plain English.

scenes.narration: One terahash per second means one trillion hash attempts every second.
So a miner at one hundred terahash per second makes one hundred trillion attempts each second.
Even so, finding a block is down to probability. Your chance is your share of the network.

cta: Does that help? Tell me in the comments, and the link is on my channel page.
title: TH/s in Plain English: What It Really Means
description_body: One terahash per second is one trillion hashes every second.
